title: Gaussian Point Splatting
summary: Gaussian Point Splatting is a rendering technique presented at SIGGRAPH 2026, representing an advancement in point-based neural rendering that enables efficient 3D scene representation and real-time view synthesis through gaussian-based point primitives.
problem_solved: Enables efficient real-time 3D scene rendering and novel view synthesis with improved visual quality and computational performance.
why_valuable: Advances the state-of-the-art in neural rendering by providing a more efficient and visually accurate approach to 3D reconstruction and real-time view synthesis compared to traditional mesh-based methods.
